since.description: First SAP_BASIS release that supports the feature, with the support package for 7.40, for example "7.02" or "7.40 SP08".

syntax.description: Short example shown in the generated table.

older.description: What to write on releases before `since`.

checked_by.description: abaplint (grammar and syntax check) or a feature rule id from config/sap-environments.yaml.

validator_from.description: Only when the offline check accepts the feature later than SAP does: the first release it accepts.

file.description: abapGit file name for a non-program source such as a CDS view; the test is then the whole file.

test.description: Program body after REPORT that uses the feature and nothing newer.

test_older.description: The same logic without the feature; must pass on the release before `since`.

source.description: Where the release fact comes from.
